findings.statement: The identical exact-rank degree-2 GF(2)^2 model class is consistent on complete 4x4-k4: 105,450 T2-O equations and zero contradictions.
The 4x4-k4 degree-1 submodel reproduces exactly the prior 168 contradictions before pair interactions are enabled, preserving the frozen producer and falsifier.
Both carriers that falsified independent exact-rank component valuation, 5x3-k3 and 4x4-k4, become consistent under the same structurally defined degree-2 extension while Q remains unchanged.

The current bounded evidence supports polynomial degree <=2 as a cross-carrier candidate for D_G on the frozen T2-O exact-rank component-parity quotient. It does not yet establish a general theorem or minimal pair basis.

The 4x4-k4 degree-2 existence system is again highly underdetermined: 5,232 observed quadratic variables and active nullity 4,843. Full pair expansion is therefore an existence probe, not the desired simple final evaluator.

Because degree two now passes both known exact-rank affine-failure carriers, the next valid step is a fresh geometry holdout chosen before observing its degree-2 outcome, followed by sparse interaction minimization only if transfer survives.

nonclaims: No general quadratic theorem is promoted.
No sparse or canonical pair valuation has been identified.
The result does not imply the degree-2 coefficient solution is unique.
next_question: Does the frozen exact-rank degree-2 model class survive a fresh wider geometry that contributed neither to the component/T2 definition nor to the quadratic hypothesis?
